//: Mechanical rails for review sessions in this directory. The reviewer agents' prompts promise: never install, never --fix or format, never a state-changing git command. Those promises were prose; these deny rules are the mechanism for their routine forms. HONEST LIMIT: prefix rules are a tripwire, not a sandbox — a chained or re-spelled command can evade them, so the prompt rails stay primary and the read-only check (tree hash before/after a run) stays the outcome verification. This file rides along with `cp -R plants <lab>`, so every lab enforces it without a step anyone can forget.
